problems.problem: The text states that the truncation of the C-terminal helix 'abolishes the directionality of the susceptibility' (implies zero or near-zero asymmetry), while the Results section states that truncation 'leaves the clockwise value [0.7] unchanged, so that the channel becomes nearly isotropic.' A nearly isotropic channel (ratio ~1:1) is not equivalent to an 'abolished' directionality.
